paite: David hong upa in, ahong tek mahmahta hi. Huchi in puan in akhuh zel ua, himahleh lum asa thei tuan kei hi.
heading: Kumpipa David Ahong Upata
english: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

paite: Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ka toupa kumpipa a ding in nungak zong le ungla; kumpipa kiangchin ah om gige henla, kemleh; na angsung ah hong lumleh, ka toupa kumpipa'n lum ahon sa thei ding," achi uhi.
english: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

paite: Huchi in Israel gam tengteng ah nungak melhoih azong ua, Shunam mi Abishag ava mu ua, kumpipa kiang ah api uhi.
english: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

paite: Huai nungak amel ahoih mahmah a, kumpipa akem a, anek-tak abawlsak hi. Himahleh, kumpipa'n amah akithuahpih kei hi.
english: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

paite: Haggith tapa Adonijah in, "Kei kumpipa a pang ding ka hi ve," chi in akingai thupi mahmah hi. Kangtalai leh sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga ama a tai dingte toh akisasak hi.
heading: Adonijah In Laltutphah Atuh
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

paite: Apa'n lah chik lai in leng, "Bangziak a hichibang a hih na hia?" chi in alungkhamsak ngei kei hi. Amah melhoih mahmah a, Absalom sangpa ahi.
english: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

paite: Ama'n Zeruiah tapa Joab leh siampu Abiathar thu adong a; amau Adonijah lam ah apang ua, amah apanpih uhi.
english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

paite: Siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, zawlnei Nathan, Shimei, Rei leh David pawl a mihangsante bel Adonijah lam ah apang kei uhi.
english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

paite: Adonijah in belamte, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute Zoheleth' Suang ah agou a, huai tuh En-rogel kiangchin a om ahi. Kumpipa tapate, a-unau tengteng leh Judah gam a kumpipa sikha tengteng achial hi.
english: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

paite: Zawlnei Nathan, Benaiah, mihangsante leh a-unaupa Solomon bel achial kei hi.
english: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

paite: Nathan in Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah, "Haggith tapa Adonijah, i toupa David theih louh in vaihawm in a-om chih za lou na hi maw?
heading: Kumpipa A Solomon Bawl Ahi
english: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?

paite: Na bitna ding leh na tapa Solomon bitna ding ka hon hilh ding.
english: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

paite: Kumpipa David kiang ah va lut inla, akiang ah, Aw toupa, ka kumpipa, na sikhanu kiang ah na tapa Solomon, ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei dia, amah ka laltutphah ah atu ding, chi in na kichiam ahi kei maw? Bang achia Adonijah in vaihawm ahia?" va chi dih achi hi.
english: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

paite: "Ngai in, kumpipa na va houpih laitak in ke'n leng ka hon zui lut sam dia, na thugen ka hon hihkippih ding," chi in agen hi.
english: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”

paite: Bathsheba kumpipa kiang ah indan ah ava lut a; kumpipa a-upa mahmahta a, Shunam mi Abishag in kumpipa nek-tak a na bawl hi.
english: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

paite: Bathsheba in kumpipa kun in zahtakna apia hi. Kumpipa'n, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
english: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka toupa aw, TOUPA na Pathian min lou in na sikhanu kiang ah, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding a, amah ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi in na kichiam khinta hi.
english: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by Yahweh your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

paite: Ngai in, tu in Adonijah lah alal a; nang ka kumpipa toupa'n lah na thei kei hi.
english: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.

paite: Bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng leh siampu Abiathar leh sepaih heutu Joab achial a, na sikha Solomon achial kei hi.
english: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

paite: Huchi in toupa aw, ka toupa nung a alaltutphah a kua hong tu ding ahia chih na gen ding in, Israelte tengteng mit nang ka toupa kumpipa tung ah atu hi.
english: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

paite: Huchi lou in zaw hichi ahi ding a, toupa kumpipa apute kiang a a-ihmut sam hun chiang in, kei leh ka tapa Solomon thil hihkhial in ahon sep mai ding uh,” achi hi.
english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

paite: Ngai in, huchi a kumpipa ahoupih laitak in, zawlnei Nathan ava lut sam hi.
english: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

paite: "En dih, zawlnei Nathan ahong," chi in kumpipa ahilh uh. Kumpipa kiang ava tun in, kumpipa ma ah amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

paite: Nathan in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka nung ah Adonijah alal dia, ka laltutphah ah atu ding na chi maw?
english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

paite: Tuni in akuansuk a, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng, sepaih heutute leh siampu Abiathar achial hi. Ngai in, ane un adawnkhawm ua, Pathian in kumpipa Adonijah hondam hen, achi uh.
english: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

paite: Himahleh kei na sikha ngei leh siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah leh na sikha Solomon ahon chial kei hi.
english: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

paite: Hiai toupa ka kumpipa thu a hih ahih ngalleh toupa ka kumpipa'n anung a laltutphah a tu dingpa akua pen ahia chih na sikhate na hilh nai lou na hi ding maw?" achi hi.
english: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

paite: Kumpipa David in adawng a, "Bathsheba hon sapsak dihua," achi hi. Kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh a, kumpipa ma ah ava dingh hi.
english: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

paite: Kumpipa akichiam a, "Lungzinna tengteng a ka hinna humbitpa TOUPA ahin bang in,
english: The king vowed and said, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

paite: na kiang a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian min lou a, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding. Ka sik in ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi a ka kichiam bang in, tuni in ka hih ding,” achi hi.
english: most certainly as I swore to you by Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”

paite: Bathsheba amai a lei si in abokkhup a, kumpipa zahtakna pia in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa David tangtawn in dam zel hen,” achi hi.
english: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”

paite: Kumpipa David in, "Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah hon va sapsak dih ua," achi hi. Amau kumpipa ma ah ava pai uhi.
english: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Na toupa uh sikhate pi unla, ka tapa Solomon keimah sabiltung mahmah ah tuangsak unla, Gihon ah pisuk un.
english: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

paite: Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Israelte kumpipa ding in thau nilh uhen. Pengkul mut unla, Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen, chi un.
english: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

paite: Huchi in amah na zuitou ding ua, ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding hi; amah lah ka sik a lal ding ahi ngal a. Amah Israel gam leh Judah gam vaihawmtu dia ka seh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in kumpipa adawng a, "Amen, TOUPA, ka toupa kumpipa Pathian in leng pha sa hen.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.

paite: TOUPA ka toupa kumpipa kiang a a-om bang in, Solomon kiang ah leng om sam henla, ka toupa kumpipa David laltutphah sang in alaltutphah hih thupizaw hen," achi hi.
english: As Yahweh has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite ahohsuk ua, David sabiltung tung ah Solomon atuangsak ua, Gihon ah api uhi.
english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

paite: Siampu Zadok in puanin a pan thau koihna ala a, Solomon anilh hi. Pengkul amut ua, huchi in mi tengteng in, "Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen," achi uhi.
english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

paite: Mi tengteng in amah azuitou ua, mite'n tamngaite atum ua, akipak mahmah ua, ahusa ging un lei akheng hi.
english: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.

paite: Adonijah leh amichial, akiang a om tengteng in ankuang alui khit un aza ua, Joab in pengkul mutging azak in, "Khopi sung a husa ging zuazua bangchidan ahia le?" achi hi.
english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”

paite: Huai achih laitak in, ngai in, siampu Abiathar tapa Jonathan ava hoh a, Adonijah in, "Hong pai dih ve, nang zaw mikizen na hi a, tanchinhoih na hon tun mahmah ding," ana chi hi.
english: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”

paite: Jonathan in adawng a, Adonijah kiang ah, "Tun ke'ng e, toupa aw, kumpipa David in Solomon kumpipa in abawl khinta hi.
english: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

paite: Amah toh siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite kumpipa'n asawl a, kumpipa sabiltung tung ah atuangsak uhi.
english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.

paite: Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Gihon ah kumpipa ding in thau anilh uh. Huai a pan nuamsatak in apaitou ua, huai in khopi sung athawn zuazua hi. Husa na zak uh huai ahi,” achi hi.
english: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

paite: Huchi in Solomon leng lalgam tutphah ah atuta hi.
english: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

paite: Kumpipa sikhate i toupa kumpipa David vualzawl ding in ahong ua, "Pathian in na min sang in Solomon min hihhoih zaw henla, na laltutphah sang in ama laltutphah hih thupizaw hen,” ahong chi uh. Huchi in kumpipa lupna tung ah akun hi.
english: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.

paite: Kumpipa'n leng, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, tuni mahmah a ka laltutphah a tu ding hon pepa phat in om hen. Ka mit mahmah in amuta,” achi hi.
english: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”

paite: Adonijah michial tengteng in alauta ua, athou ua, alampi chiat uah apaivekta uhi.
english: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.

paite: Adonijah in Solomon alau a, athou a, maitam kii ava len hi.
english: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.

paite: "Ngai in, Adonijah in kumpipa Solomon alau a; kumpipa Solomon in asikha namsau a that lou ding in ka kiang ah kichiam phot hen," chi in maitam kii alen hi chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.
english: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”

paite: Solomon in, "Miginomtak ahih asuklat peuhmahleh asamzang khat leng lei ah ake kei ding. Gitlouhna anei chih theihna a-omleh bel asi ding," achi hi.
english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in mi asawl a, maitam a pan ava pisuk ua, amah ava hoh a, kumpipa Solomon ma ah akun hi. Solomon in akiang ah, "Na inn ah pai in," ana chi hi.
english: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”
